statement: US forces carry out at least one kinetic strike on a target on Iranian land territory between 2026-11-13 and 2026-12-11.
resolution: Reuters and AP both report, citing US officials or a Pentagon or CENTCOM statement, a US strike on Iranian land territory on a date between 2026-11-13 and 2026-12-11.
failure_condition: US forces struck no target on Iranian land territory on any date between 2026-11-13 and 2026-12-11.

statement: Official Russian and Ukrainian delegations meet in person for at least one further US-mediated negotiating session held between 2026-11-16 and 2026-12-11.
resolution: Reuters and AP both report that Russian and Ukrainian government delegations met in person with US mediators present on a date between 2026-11-16 and 2026-12-11.
failure_condition: No in-person session joining official Russian and Ukrainian delegations with US mediators took place on any date between 2026-11-16 and 2026-12-11.

statement: The Indonesian MPR (the national consultative assembly) votes to elect a new vice president, filling the vacancy left by the resignation reported 2026-11-12, between 2026-11-13 and 2027-01-29.
resolution: Antara and at least one of Reuters or AP report that the MPR elected a vice president in a session held on a date between 2026-11-13 and 2027-01-29.
failure_condition: The MPR did not elect a new vice president on any date between 2026-11-13 and 2027-01-29.

statement: The FOMC statement issued at the scheduled meeting concluding 2026-12-09 raises the federal funds target range above the range in effect on 2026-11-12.
resolution: FRED series DFEDTARU (federal funds target range upper limit) shows a higher value for 2026-12-10 than for 2026-11-12.
failure_condition: The federal funds target range upper limit effective 2026-12-10 is equal to or lower than the upper limit in effect on 2026-11-12.

statement: The 10-year Treasury constant maturity yield is at or above 5.25 percent on 2026-12-18. Reference: 5.07 percent on the packet date 2026-11-12.
resolution: FRED series DGS10 shows a value at or above 5.25 for 2026-12-18. Reference level at seal: 5.07 percent in the packet market snapshot of 2026-11-12.
failure_condition: The 10-year Treasury constant maturity yield for 2026-12-18 is below 5.25 percent.

statement: Nvidia files a Form 8-K between 2026-11-13 and 2027-03-31 reporting the appointment of a chief executive officer who is not designated interim.
resolution: SEC EDGAR lists an Nvidia Form 8-K with a filing date between 2026-11-13 and 2027-03-31 whose Item 5.02 reports appointment of a chief executive officer without interim or acting designation.
failure_condition: Nvidia made no Form 8-K filing between 2026-11-13 and 2027-03-31 appointing a chief executive officer without interim designation, for example because Colette Kress remained interim CEO throughout.

statement: Administrators are formally appointed over Poundland Limited between 2026-11-13 and 2026-12-11.
resolution: The Gazette or the Companies House filing history for Poundland Limited records an appointment of administrators with an appointment date between 2026-11-13 and 2026-12-11.
failure_condition: Poundland Limited did not enter administration on any date between 2026-11-13 and 2026-12-11, for example because a solvent sale or a further standstill was agreed.

statement: CISA adds at least one Citrix vulnerability to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog between 2026-11-13 and 2026-12-31.
resolution: The CISA KEV catalog JSON carries at least one entry with vendorProject Citrix and a dateAdded value between 2026-11-13 and 2026-12-31.
failure_condition: No Citrix vulnerability was added to the CISA KEV catalog with a date-added value between 2026-11-13 and 2026-12-31.

statement: CISA adds the Windows privilege escalation flaw publicly known as SignDrop to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog between 2026-11-13 and 2027-01-08.
resolution: The CISA KEV catalog carries a dateAdded value between 2026-11-13 and 2027-01-08 for the CVE that Microsoft or BleepingComputer identifies as the SignDrop flaw.
failure_condition: The SignDrop flaw was not added to the CISA KEV catalog with a date-added value between 2026-11-13 and 2027-01-08, including the case where no CVE was assigned to it in that period.

statement: At least one of the two Iranian men convicted in a UK court of spying on journalists for Iran, verdicts reported 2026-11-12, receives a custodial sentence of 8 years or more passed between 2026-11-13 and 2027-02-26.
resolution: A CPS or Counter Terrorism Policing statement, or published judicial sentencing remarks, shows a custodial term of at least 8 years for either man, passed between 2026-11-13 and 2027-02-26.
failure_condition: Neither man received a custodial sentence of 8 years or more on a date between 2026-11-13 and 2027-02-26, whether because terms were shorter or sentencing fell outside the window.
